# OPUS sample files

The four OPUS files here are copied unchanged from the `opusreader2` R package
(<https://github.com/spectral-cockpit/opusreader2>, `inst/extdata/test_data`,
commit `77a1ee4b1c61247d5075a4da7205b6a9969428bf`), whose `DESCRIPTION` states
`License: MIT + file LICENSE` with `LICENSE` reading `YEAR: 2025` and
`COPYRIGHT HOLDER: opusreader2 authors`. The files are the package's own sample
data, shipped inside it under that licence, and are used here under it.

`soil_pair.zip` is an archive of `617262_1TP_C-1_A5.0` and
`629266_1TP_A-1_C1.0`, made here, so the reader's zip path has a real pair to
read: two soil spectra from one instrument whose axes differ by 0.27 cm-1.
